reviews.comment: I truly dislike English with a passion but this prof made the class interesting. He really cares about his students and he's very understanding. There is a lot of participation discussions and our final was a research paper. He was very accessible outside of class. I highly recommend taking this prof. 10/10
He's super caring and easily accessible outside of class. Grade was mostly three papers that you wrote over the whole semester. Most of class was discussion, it helps if you participate.

First of all, this class is amazing!! The prof is the sweetest and is super understanding. The works you need to read are provided in pdf form so you don't need to buy anything! But the class is exam heavy so beware.

reviews.comment: This professor is quite possibly my favorite professor ever! Very interesting classes that introduce you to new readings. You will have to read a good amount for every week. We averaged probably 75 pages per week. The grade is based on quizzes from the readings, one shorter paper, one group project, and one longer paper. Overall, great class!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters
